items.title: The Bull Case For Brown-Forman (BF.B) Could Change Following CEO Exit And Dividend Reaffirmation – Learn Why
items.summary: Brown-Forman’s July 23, 2026 board meeting approved a regular quarterly cash dividend of US$0.2310 per share, extending an 82-year record of uninterrupted payouts and 42 years of dividend increases for both its Class A and Class B stock.
